```{r}
ts_data$`Month-Year` <- dmy(

```

```{r}
ts_tsibble <- ts_data %>%
```

# 1 Visualising Time-series Data

transfer to long data first

```{r}
ts_longer <- ts_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(2:34),
               names_to = "Country",
               values_to = "Arrivals")
```

```{r}
ts_longer
```

```{r}
ts_longer %>%
  filter(Country == "Vietnam") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = `Month-Year`, 
             y = Arrivals))+
  geom_line(size = 0.5)
```

use facet_wrap() to wrap cause countries have different volume

can use fig-height: 20 for adjust quator plot size

```{r}
#| fig-height: 20
ggplot(data = ts_longer, 
       aes(x = `Month-Year`, 
           y = Arrivals))+
  geom_line(size = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ Country,
             ncol = 3,
             scales = "free_y") +
  theme_bw()
```

123

```{r}
ts_tsibble <- ts_data %>%
  mutate(Month = yearmonth(`Month-Year`)) %>%
  as_tsibble(index = `Month`)

tsibble_longer <- ts_tsibble %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(2:34),
               names_to = "Country",
               values_to = "Arrivals")
```

```{r}
str(tsibble_longer
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 6
tsibble_longer %>%
  filter(Country == "Vietnam" |
         Country == "Italy") %>% 
  gg_subseries(Arrivals)
```

ACF\

```{r}
tsibble_longer %>%
  filter(`Country` == "Vietnam") %>%
  ACF(Arrivals) %>% 
  autoplot()
```

forecasting\

```{r}
vietnam_ts <- tsibble_longer %>%
  filter(Country == "Vietnam") %>% 
  mutate(Type = if_else(
    `Month-Year` >= "2019-01-01", 
    "Hold-out", "Training"))
```

```{r}
vietnam_train <- vietnam_ts %>%
  filter(`Month-Year` < "2019-01-01")
```
